title: Minimum Prefix Removal to Make Array Strictly Increasing
summary: Given an integer array nums, you need to remove exactly one prefix (which may be empty) from the array.
statement: Given an integer array nums, you need to remove exactly one prefix (which may be empty) from the array. The goal is to ensure that the remaining array is strictly increasing. Return the minimum length of the prefix that needs to be removed to achieve this.
constraints: nums has up to 100,000 signed integers.
Remove one prefix, which may be empty or leave a singleton.
Minimize the removed length so the remainder is strictly increasing.
hints: Only the longest strictly increasing suffix can remain after removing a prefix.
Scan adjacent pairs from right to left until finding the rightmost non-increasing pair.
Remove through its left endpoint, which means returning the right index of that pair.
Everything to its right is increasing by the scan, while keeping any earlier start would retain this violating pair.
editorial: Everything to its right is increasing by the scan, while keeping any earlier start would retain this violating pair.

tests.explanation: The longest increasing suffix is [3,4,5], beginning at index four.
The full array is already strictly increasing, so remove zero values.
